Remove datasets from the local store

Source: R/store.R
bdhs_forget.Rd

Unregisters datasets so that bdhs_read() no longer finds them. Stored copies are deleted only with delete = TRUE (after confirmation in interactive sessions). Original files that were registered in place with bdhs_import(copy = FALSE) are never deleted.

Usage

bdhs_forget(survey, recode = NULL, delete = FALSE)

Arguments

survey

A survey reference (see bdhs_survey_id()).

recode

Recode codes to forget; NULL forgets every recode of the survey.

delete

If TRUE, also delete the copies kept in the store.

Value

The removed registry rows, invisibly.

See also

Other data store: bdhs_data_dir(), bdhs_download(), bdhs_identify_file(), bdhs_import(), bdhs_inventory(), bdhs_read(), bdhs_read_file(), bdhs_sitrep()

Examples

f <- file.path(tempdir(), "BDKR81FL.DTA")
haven::write_dta(bdhs_simulate(2022, "KR", n_clusters = 4, households = 3), f)
bdhs_import(f, format = "dta", quiet = TRUE)
bdhs_forget(2022, "KR", delete = TRUE)
#> ✔ Deleted the stored copy of "BD2022DHS KR".
#> ✔ Unregistered "BD2022DHS KR".
